note: Centralized display-time cost metadata used by the evaluation pipeline and dashboard. Prices are USD per 1M tokens. The dashboard reprices immutable token facts from this current file; it does not trust historical snapshot estimates. Explicitly unresolved models are never priced from defaults. Cache reads use cached_input; cache writes use cache_write when present and otherwise the cache-miss/input rate.

gpt-5.5.note: Official OpenAI Standard price for gpt-5.5 with <272K context. The official row does not publish a cache-write rate or establish the >272K tier, so cache writes fall back to input and this flat estimate is limited to the published short-context tier. Retrieved 2026-08-16.
